description:
The geography of a reservation
Reservations consist of
* Contact data: the name, email and telephone of the requesters, the acceptance of terms & conditions, presence of specific people, notes
* trek data: the actual path with dates, stops (places where to sleep) and particpants

Both parts are identified and linked by an ID (a 6 digit casual string) which represents the identification code of the reservation as a whole

The trek data are copied and kept update with a corresponding table of presences, which is used to trace the actual number of particpants and the actual path (i.e. record changes in stops ...)
